headlines.title: 'K-국부펀드' 설립 논의 시작 …" 상반기 중 방안 마련 "
headlines.summary: 재경부, 한국판 국부펀드 설립 방향 논의 위한 간담회 "유망산업에 장기 지분 투자…미래 세대와 국부 나눌 것" "상반기 중 설립 방안 마련하고 국회에 법안 제출 예정" [세종=뉴시스] 강종민 기자 = 세종시 어진동 정부세종청사 재정경제부. 2026.01.06. ppkjm@newsis.

headlines.title: 임광현 국세청장 “ 다주택자 편법 증여, 가산세 40% 물 수도 ”
headlines.summary: SNS 통해 편법증여 전수 검증 예고 “정상이면 양도가 증여보다 부담적어” 다음달 9일 다주택자 양도소득세 중과 유예가 종료되는 가운데 임광현 국세청장이 29일 세금을 피하기 위한 다주택자들의 편법 증여를 철저하게 검증하겠다고 밝혔다.

headlines.title: 서울 60㎡ 이하 소형 아파트 평균가 10억 넘었다
headlines.summary: 대출 규제·전세난에 중저가 매수 쏠림 6개월새 11%↑, 모든 면적 중 상승률 최고 “구매력 부족 실수요자, 작은 아파트 몰려” 서울의 60㎡ 이하 소형 아파트 평균 가격이 처음으로 10억원을 돌파했다. 대출 한도 축소가 덜한 중저가 아파트로 매수세가 모이며, ‘좁은 집’의 몸값이 폭등하고 있는 것으로 풀이된다.

headlines.title: 정부 ‘ 건설사 구하기 ’… 표준단가 공시 연기
headlines.summary: 예년보다 일주일 늦춰 내달 8일 중동전쟁 여파 물가인상분 반영 중동전쟁 장기화에 따른 공사비 급등으로 건설사들의 부담이 커지자 정부가 건설사 구하기에 나섰다. 올해 하반기 발주될 공공 공사의 표준 단가 발표 시기를 일주일가량 연기해 전쟁에 따른 물가 인상분을 최대한 반영하기로 한 것이다.

headlines.title: 나프타 보조금에 업계 ‘ 숨통 ’… 스폿 물량 확보
headlines.summary: 여천NCC 가동률 55 → 65% 극단적인 공급절벽 상황 완화 원료값 비싸 ‘역마진’은 여전 미국·이란 전쟁발 나프타 수급난에 직격탄을 맞았던 국내 석유화학기업들이 나프타분해시설(NCC) 가동률을 높이면서 극한 위기 상황은 넘어간 것으로 분석됐다.

headlines.title: 중동사태에 기업들 투자 미루고 부채상환
headlines.summary: 지난달 회사채 잔액 0.2% 감소 발행 목적도 차환 용도가 85% 시설 투자 위한 발행액은 ‘제로’ 중동 전쟁과 고금리 여파로 불확실성이 커지면서 기업들이 미래를 위한 투자보다는 당장의 생존을 위해 부채 상환에 주력하는 것으로 나타났다.

headlines.title: 원전 업계, 해외 진출 경험 부족... 정부 "첫걸음 지원 강화 "
headlines.summary: <연합뉴스> 정부가 원전 수출 업계를 돕기 위해 해외인증 취득 등 수출지원사업을 확대한다. 수출실적이 부족한 중소·중견기업엔 '수출 첫걸음 지원정책'을 강화한다. 산업통상자원부는 20일 한국원전수출산업협회와 공동으로 '원전 기업을 위한 수출 설명회'를 갖고 이같이 밝혔다.

headlines.title: 뽑겠다는 중기, 일하겠다는 외국인 … 현장선 ‘ 미스매치 ’ 심각
headlines.summary: 중진공, 중기·유학생 대상 조사 기업·외국인 약 80% ‘채용·취업 희망’ 정부·지자체, 공공 취업매칭 강화 필요 네팔에서 온 외국인 근로자들이 인천국제공항 제2터미널을 통해 입국하고 있다.  [뉴시스] 중소기업 10곳 중 8곳가량은 외국인 유학생과 구직자를 채용할 의향이 있는 것으로 나타났다.

headlines.title: 女 가사노동 가치 연 1천650만원 … 성별 격차 3.2→2.7배로 축소
headlines.summary: 가사노동 총가치 582조·GDP 대비 23%…외주화·가전 발달로 비중은 하락 반려동·식물 돌봄 60% 늘어…미성년 -1.8%, 성인 20.8% 여성 1인 가사노동 연 1천650만원…남성, 여전히 '3분의 1' 수준 [연합뉴스TV 제공] (세종=연합뉴스) 안채원 기자 = 여성 1명이 가사노동으로 창출하는 가치가 약 1천646만원에 달하는 것으로 조사됐다.

headlines.title: 돈 안 받는 집안일도 GDP 23% 규모 … 582조 가치

headlines.title: 60세 이상 정년연장시 임금 조정 …재계 ‘연령차별 예외’ 法명시 요구...

key_headlines.title: LG Energy Solution Secures Major BMW EV Battery Supply Contract Worth 10 Trillion Won
key_headlines.summary: LG Energy Solution will supply cylindrical batteries for BMW's next-generation electric vehicle platform, marking the company's first major battery supply deal with the German automaker and strengthening its competitive position in the global EV battery market.

sections.Hot Economy News: South Korea is establishing a sovereign wealth fund to make long-term investments in promising industries and secure intergenerational wealth. Seoul's small apartments under 60 square meters have broken through the 1 billion won price barrier for the first time, driven by concentrated buyer demand amid lending restrictions and charter housing shortages. The government delayed announcing construction standard prices by one week to reflect Middle East war-related inflation impacts on construction costs. Domestic petrochemical companies are recovering from naphtha supply shortages by increasing facility utilization rates with spot purchases. The tax authority announced strict verification of multi-property owners' illegal gift transfers with potential 40% surcharge penalties as temporary tax relief expires.
sections.Macro & Fiscal Policy: South Korea's first quarter GDP growth reached a 5.5-year high, and April exports showed significant year-over-year increases, demonstrating economic resilience despite external challenges. President Lee Myung-bak emphasized price stability measures and pledged zero tolerance for market manipulation and hoarding as producer prices surge. The government is concerned about Middle East geopolitical risks and inflation spreading to consumer prices, necessitating comprehensive stabilization efforts. With the Federal Reserve maintaining interest rates at 3.50-3.75% amid inflation concerns, South Korea faces complex monetary policy decisions. The new Bank of Korea governor's inflation assessment will be closely watched by financial markets.
sections.Financial Markets: The KOSPI declined 1.38% to close at 6598.87 as international oil prices surged and the Federal Reserve signaled hawkish rate hold, causing foreign investors to net sell 1.46 trillion won worth of shares. The KOSDAQ fell 2.29% to 1192.35 as market uncertainty increased from the Fed's unclear inflation outlook and geopolitical tensions. The dollar-won exchange rate closed the week at 1483.3 won, up 4.3 won from the previous day. Three of the Federal Reserve's 12 committee members unusually opposed language maintaining an accommodative policy stance, creating increased uncertainty in global financial markets including Korea. U.S. stock markets showed mixed results amid elevated oil prices and the Fed's policy stance.
sections.Industry & Technology: Samsung Electro-Mechanics recorded strong first quarter performance with operating profit up 40% year-over-year, driven by increased AI server and advanced driving assistance system component supplies. LG Energy Solution secured a major 10 trillion won battery supply contract with BMW for next-generation electric vehicles, marking its first supply deal with the German automaker. Hyundai Motor Group is piloting a battery subscription service where consumers can purchase electric vehicles while leasing batteries separately. LG Chem recorded losses due to weak battery demand and geopolitical risks, though its petrochemical division remained profitable. Companies are accelerating shifts toward high-value, high-profit business portfolios to maintain stability amid volatile economic cycles.
sections.Real Estate: Seoul apartments of 59 square meters are increasingly supplied over the traditional 84 square meter national standard size, as developers can increase unit counts and boost sales revenue with minimal price differences. Small apartment prices are surging due to limited purchasing power of actual residents facing tightened lending regulations and charter housing shortages. Price appreciation is spreading from Seoul's Han River belt areas to outer Seoul and Gyeonggi Province as prices rise faster in alternative markets. The rental market structure is rapidly shifting from charter deposits to monthly rent, with monthly rent proportions reaching 68.3% nationally and exceeding 70% in Seoul and other regions. The Suzan Landscape project in Pyeongtek's Goduk International City will open sample houses on May 8th with 1,126 units supplied at approximately 500 million won for 84 square meter units.
sections.International Economy: The Federal Reserve maintained interest rates at 3.50-3.75% for three consecutive meetings amid inflation concerns linked to Middle East energy prices and geopolitical uncertainty. Fed Chairman Powell refused to resign and emphasized the Fed's independence from political pressure, while three committee members opposed the dovish policy language, indicating increasing policy divisions. The U.S. economy remains resilient with stable employment and controlled inflation, though energy price volatility and geopolitical risks pose downside risks. Tensions between Fed leadership and the Trump administration over monetary policy are intensifying, potentially causing market confusion. U.S.-Iran military conflict uncertainty continues to constrain global financial markets and economic outlooks.
sections.AI & Economy: U.S. tech giants Meta, Microsoft, Amazon, and Alphabet reported first quarter earnings exceeding market expectations, validating AI infrastructure investments' profitability through cloud and advertising revenue growth. Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix are benefiting from increased AI data center investments by major tech companies requiring high-bandwidth memory chips as essential components. Anthropic, developer of the Claude large language model, is seeking funding at a 900 billion dollar valuation, potentially surpassing OpenAI as the world's most valuable AI startup. Microsoft's cloud service Azure recorded 40% revenue growth, while Amazon and other major tech firms showed significant cloud segment expansion. AI infrastructure investments are translating into tangible business results, countering earlier market concerns about AI investment bubbles.
sections.Others: Public institutions' debt ratio declined 6.4 percentage points year-over-year to 174.1%, while new hiring expanded by 7,000 to reach 27,000 positions, demonstrating improved financial health across 342 public organizations. The government is transitioning foreign worker policies to integrated full-lifecycle management systems, planning to ease workplace movement restrictions and employment period regulations under the reformed employment permit system. Woori Bank launched U.S. investment briefing sessions to support small and medium-sized enterprises' overseas expansion amid increased local production setup demand from U.S. tariff negotiations. Public institutions' average employee annual salary reached 74 million won, reflecting workforce composition across Korea's government-affiliated organizations. The government is systematizing foreign worker integration support through comprehensive policy coordination.
